Effect-first component proposal. The dataset-918082155360 experiment uses the rna layer to
assess the declared condition target contrasts treatment with control. (A) The declared target
observations are shown for component PC1. (B) The declared target observations are shown for
component PC2. The red diamond marks the uniquely nominated component; black and white marks
retain the complete ranked search. The analysis unit is independent biological observation; the
design is cross_sectional; the estimand is signed-rank-biserial. Facet labels report stored
effect rank and magnitude. Raw p-values are retained; q-values use Holm correction across
declared components within each metadata field and evidence variant. No acceptance threshold is
applied. The proposal is exploratory and does not confirm biological validity.
